root_cause.text: The error path in `__ip_vs_get_out_rt()` calls `dst_link_failure(skb)` without ensuring `skb->dev` is set, causing a NULL pointer dereference when `fib_compute_spec_dst()` subsequently accesses `skb->dev`.
root_cause.evidence: The commit message describes the crash chain: __ip_vs_get_out_rt() -> dst_link_failure() -> ipv4_link_failure() -> ipv4_send_dest_unreach() -> __ip_options_compile() -> fib_compute_spec_dst(), which dereferences NULL skb->dev. The patch adds a check `if (!skb->dev) skb->dev = skb_dst(skb)->dev;` before calling dst_link_failure, mirroring the IPv6 fix. The KASAN call trace confirms the null-ptr-deref at `fib_compute_spec_dst+0x17a` and `__in_dev_get_rcu` in `fib_compute_spec_dst`.
